decision: quorum llm is a standalone diagnostic command that probes all providers in parallel and renders a status panel with active badge and per-provider setup hints.
key_insight: quorum llm is a standalone diagnostic command that probes all providers in parallel and renders a status panel with active badge and per-provider setup hints.
alternatives_considered: Embed LLM status in quorum status command
Interactive wizard that prompts user to pick a provider
rejected_reason: quorum status is already dense — LLM setup is a distinct first-run concern
Interactive prompts add complexity; zero-config auto-detection is the design principle — the command should show what was found, not ask what to use
